headline: Iran-backed Houthis announce blockade. And, Cyclospora source remains unknown
context: Iran-backed Houthis say they will blockade a waterway on the Red Sea. And, the FDA continues to investigate Taylor Farms lettuce as a source of the Cyclospora outbreak despite a retracted test.
